property_summary: For any actor and amount, Collect must never reduce the actor's Acc balance unless block.timestamp is strictly greater than the actor's stored unlockTime; the mutant relaxes this to >=, so it can collect at exactly unlockTime.
change_summary: Change the IF condition line 18 from `block.timestamp>acc.unlockTime` to `block.timestamp>=acc.unlockTime`, so Collect can succeed exactly at unlockTime.
